verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Asana's AI agents/AI Studio/Dash offer workflow automation, but nothing indicates the AI assistant learns a user's tone, shorthand, or personal preferences to tailor its output. No mention of personalization, memory of user writing style, or adaptive tone in any of the docs or community items. Missing for 10: any documentation of personalized tone/style learning, user-specific memory of shorthand/preferences, or examples of tailored output based on individual user habits.
